quote_zh: 「海女」這個說法其實是受日韓影響，台灣早期沒有這個稱呼。現在我們比較常說「海洋採集者」——因為潮間帶採集不是女生專屬，男生也會下去抓龍蝦、海膽。
quote_en: The term "sea-women" is really shaped by Japanese and Korean usage — Taiwan didn't historically use it. These days we tend to say "ocean gatherers" instead, since intertidal gathering isn't limited to women; men go out for lobster and sea urchin too.
